newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGAS ALUS BREWERY BACK IN Q1 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: RIGAS ALUS BREWERY BACK IN Q1 PROFIT.

text.p: Rigas Alus brewerey's first quarter profit came to 113,021 lats on net turnover of 580,794 lats, the Riga stock exchange said on Friday.
The company earlier reported a 1996 loss of 396,504 lats on net turnover of 1.79 million lats.
The company reported production costs of 508,144 lats in the first quarter and distribution costs of 15,954 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
Rigas Alus spent 5,228 lats in administrative costs.
Its balance sheet total came to 1.23 million lats, with 380,216 lats in stocks and 202,055 lats in payments due.
Its equity capital was 932,272 lats and it had reserves of 343,248 lats, the bourse said.
The company posted a negative figure for retained earnings brought forward from previous years of 1.12 million lats and 953,803 lats in short-term liabilities.
